renew_lease: Request a fresh DHCP lease using captured IPv4 policy when dhcp_lease_present is false.
restore_dns: Restore only captured DNS configuration when dns_matches_snapshot is false.
restore_gateway: Restore captured IPv4 routing configuration when gateway_matches_snapshot is false.
restore_ipv4: Restore captured IPv4 configuration and request DHCP when ipv4_usable is false or ipv4_linklocal is true.
restore_mtu: Restore the captured interface MTU when mtu_matches_snapshot is false.
restore_proxy: Restore only captured web and secure proxy configuration when proxy_matches_snapshot is false.
